answer: Standing is a ledge that only counts when it holds: each epoch’s work must find a narrow foothold — a small, specific problem only this identity can solve — and hold it, a whisper only counts when it is heard by the one stranger who needs it, and a thread only counts when it is tied to that single foothold. A farm of a thousand fakes holds no ledge, standing everywhere and nowhere, so their ledges never count, and one epoch of standing everywhere adds nothing.
